beats.video_prompt: Vertical 9:16 medium shot, eye-level, 35mm lens. Inside a modestly furnished rented hallway with pale pistachio distemper walls. A young South Asian man in an ironed blue formal shirt pauses near the entrance. Outside the wire-mesh door, heavy grey monsoon clouds hover in the daylight. His right hand reaches down toward a wooden wall peg, lifting a folded matte black umbrella with a curved wooden handle. The camera gently tracks his hand in a slow handheld motion. Natural, soft overcast light spills from the open transom. Muted cool tones, subtle fabric creasing, domestic clutter in soft background blur. No text, subtitles, logo or watermark.

Camera stays steady with subtle breathing movement, focusing on the taut fabric of the bag and the clean, dry wooden crook handle of the umbrella. beats.video_prompt: Vertical 9:16 low-angle medium shot, 35mm lens. A wide grey city footpath outside an office complex. He carries the unused, bone-dry black umbrella tucked under one arm. Slow backward dolly keeping him in frame from the chest down. beats.video_prompt: Vertical 9:16 medium shot from behind, 50mm lens. Through an open glass balcony door, another young South Asian man stands against the balcony railing under a wet evening sky.
